Initial release of tech-to-product-zhcn.  
- Provides structured guidance for turning materials or materials science technologies into real products.
- Focuses on practical application, including materials selection, processing, performance, and integration under real-world constraints.
- Defines a clear, multi-section response structure covering technology overview, product examples, system architectures, implementation steps, technical requirements, constraints, and market adoption.
- Emphasizes concise, practical, and example-driven analysis for users seeking to productize material technologies.
- Writing style is direct, application-oriented, and avoids meta-commentary and unnecessary jargon.
